name: Caster
source:
One of the three playable servants in Fate/Extra.

She is a beautiful fox woman with a cheerful disposition.

[spoiler]Her true identity is Tamamo-no-Mae, a soul that branched off from Amaterasu. Her Noble Phantasm is called Suiten Nikkou Amaterasu Yanoshisu Ishi.[/spoiler]
